pages.text: Place the case on a surface or against a wall. Sneak-right-click to open or shut the glass lid. With the case open, right-click with an item to display it. Right-click again to eject the exhibit.
Other woods and framed versions follow the same layout.

pages.title: Lining and Signal
pages.text: With no exhibit inside, right-click with carpet to add or swap the lining. Right-click the open, empty case with an empty hand for its menu. A displayed redstone block powers neighbors. Use a drill to switch mount or sneak-use it to rotate.
